answer: Farming becomes a timber bet on surviving 101 epochs of grading, and every trellis settlement recomputes the quartz schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 101 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 10 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 16 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
